Camila / team —

Risk badge: MEDIUM
Rationale (for CRM note): 
- Contracted ARR is stable but discounts and one-off PS credits represent ~12% of next-term value; billing history shows irregular invoicing cadence which increases churn uncertainty.
- Recent usage patterns stable after earlier backfill; however procurement historically pushes for a 10% list discount at renewal.

Suggested mitigation to include in the note: propose a 12-month lock + usage-based true-up clause; offer a one-time onboarding credit in lieu of increasing list discount to preserve unit economics.

I attached a short wording snippet we can paste into the renewal note and the mutual action plan (MAP) with the ask.
